headline: Iron Mountain (IRM) Could Be 20% Undervalued On Raised 2026 Revenue Outlook
summary: Iron Mountain (IRM) lifted its full year 2026 revenue outlook on 5 August, updated guidance for the third quarter, and affirmed its quarterly dividend. That combination put the stock back in focus for income oriented investors. See our latest analysis for Iron Mountain. The upbeat guidance and dividend affirmation come on top of strong recent momentum in Iron Mountain, with a year-to-date share price return of 52.73% and a 5-year total shareholder return of 230.63%.
